payload.body: One more item for the WP01 re-bank, from WP06a's critic: the full-sha regex has four copies (your release:207, WP01's new release:3401, WP03's ci-state:446, WP06a's macos:840). The one check is is_commit_sha <word> [full] in lib/helpers (full: exactly 40 or 64 lowercase hex), landing in WP03, which runs first as a stack with WP04. When you rebase onto that landing, use is_commit_sha "${2,,}" full at release:207 and the same at :3401, so WP01 adds no copy. Run 2 chains your WP01 re-bank with dc's WP06a re-bank when both are ready, else the ready one runs alone.
